Properties

Concepts

This case-sensitive code system https://bih-cei.github.io/PCOR-MII/CodeSystem/ansocq-koerperteile defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayordinalValue
1 There is no way I would be prepared to gain weight on these body parts.1
2 Sometimes I think I would be prepared to gain weight on these body parts.2
3 I have decided that I am prepared to gain weight on these body parts.3
4 I am presently trying to gain weight on these body parts.4
5 I am working to maintain the weight I gained on these body parts.5
